messages:
rahul (product): Quick company update on billing policy: two changes will launch this summer to reduce surprise charges and simplify starter credits. 1) Gradual credit taper for legacy "startup" accounts (no more open-ended credits). 2) Per-account burst cushion (short-lived cushion that defers token billing recognition for tiny spikes). Dry-run/telemetry starts 2027-05-10, soft-launch window 2027-06-01 -> 2027-07-15.

mina (finance): Important: taper is a predictable schedule that converts legacy unlimited-style credits into a time-boxed pool. Existing customers with special credit grants will be grandfathered into a custom taper plan; general legacy startup credits move to a 60-day, $200-equivalent pool. We'll publish a mapping sheet.

olga (eng-billing): Implementation notes: feature flags: credit_taper_v1, burst_cushion_v1. Burst cushion is NOT free tokens  it defers billing recognition for bursts under a per-tenant threshold for up to 10 minutes. We'll add response headers: X-Redwood-Burst-Cushion: active|dry-run and X-Redwood-Cushion-Window: 600 (seconds). CSV changes: new columns cushion_applied (true|false) and effective_billing_tokens. During dry-run we emit cushion_applied but billing uses reported_tokens.

olga (eng-billing): Dev tip: we will emit both reported_tokens and effective_billing_tokens in /v1/usage exports during May. Please avoid breaking parsers that assume a fixed schema.

tess (support): CS guidance request: what do we tell customers seeing "effective_billing_tokens" in exports during dry-run? Is this telemetry-only?

mina (finance): Yes dry-run is telemetry-only until 2027-06-01. Add this to the CS script: "You may see a new CSV column (effective_billing_tokens) during the dry-run; no invoice changes until June 1." We'll email all affected accounts 2 weeks before cutover.

noah (sales): Need a single-sentence for AEs: suggested: "We're replacing legacy unlimited testing credits with a predictable starter credit and adding a short burst cushion to reduce invoice noise from tiny spikes." Fine to use in outreach?

rahul (product): That works. Also: for customers on committed or enterprise plans, these changes are opt-in only; no forced changes. For legacy startup accounts we'll run account-level outreach.

olga (eng-billing): Technical nuance: cushion_applied will be true if a request's tokens are deferred into a cushion bucket. effective_billing_tokens will show the post-cushion amount we would bill after window expiry. We will log metric billing.cushion.deferred with tenant_id tag.

billing-bot: export ready: /exports/usage/2027-05-11/sample-tenant-usage.csv :white_check_mark:

tess (support): I'll draft canned replies and a triage checklist: 1) confirm X-Redwood-Burst-Cushion header; 2) check effective_billing_tokens vs reported_tokens; 3) escalate to eng-billing if mismatch > 5% for top accounts.

mina (finance): Action items: finance (mina) - publish mapping & email cadence; eng (olga) - feature flags + headers + dual CSVs; support (tess) - canned replies and triage checklist; sales (noah) - AE snippet. Product (rahul) owning rollout and customer comms.

noah (sales): We'll pause any promotional extensions to legacy credits until the taper is published, to avoid confusion in renewals.

rahul (product): Timeline recap: dry-run telemetry from 2027-05-10; optional pilot customers invited week of 2027-05-17; soft-launch (billing active) begins 2027-06-01; full opt-out window closes 2027-07-15. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/credit-taper-burst-cushion (internal).

olga (eng-billing): Rolling dual-emit to staging now. Will post dual-export samples in #eng-billing once available.

mina (finance): Risk note: integrations that auto-apply credits client-side could misreport available credits. Mitigation: detailed mapping guide + partner outreach + 30-day dual-view.

rahul (product): Thanks team. We'll prepare a short customer-facing FAQ and a post for partners. Ping me if you need exceptions for enterprise customers.
